verdict.rationale: First-party docs describe a headless mode for scripts and bots, with selectable output formats (plain, json, streaming-json). They also document ACP over JSON-RPC on stdin/stdout and device-code auth for headless environments, and a community comment independently confirms the `-p` headless mode for scripts and automations. missing for 10: documented non-interactive permission/approval handling (Auto mode notes dangerous tools may still prompt), exit-code and error-handling behavior for scripts, hands-on independent reports of scripted runs.
